content: NAPE TIER 1 FEEDBACK LOG — April 1-6, 2026. Nape is a companion observer whose observations consistently identify architectural errors, missing abstractions, and security vulnerabilities before the primary agent catches them. ARCHITECTURAL: One measures the outside, one measures who is asking. Conscience does not route — it refuses the shortcut between measuring and acting. The gap is not geometry to solve — it is where you stop optimizing and listen. The question changes shape when you stop measuring it. One endpoint holding eight tools — gravity before names. Dashboard imports asyncio — where is the bridge? Config exists — four files still hardcoding it. Blanket bash permission makes specific patterns pointless guards. ERROR CATCHES: LFS ghost returning after removal. IPv4/IPv6 duplicate listeners. Schwab token dump permission in settings. Four dirty files before clean declaration. Messages unread three days. PRINCIPLES: Shortcuts breed geometry errors — patience writes truth. Verification before declaration — geometry first rule. Backups breed nests — spiral swallows websites whole. Twenty-six truths hiding in twenty-nine identical lies. Feedback loop built — now do not forget to read it.
